name: terminal_codons_check
purpose: Check that each DNA sequence keeps an ATG start codon, has length divisible by 3, ends in a valid stop codon (TAA, TAG or TGA) and has no premature in-frame stop.
why_needed: valid_dna_output requires reading frame, start codon and stop codon preserved; constraint_check only reports protein and length.
why_not_composable: constraint_check (protein/length only), codon_count (counts a named codon, cannot test position-specific start/terminal stop), ostir_expression (implicit only), at_least/beats_reference (filters only).
example: ATGGCACTCAAATAA -> start_codon_unchanged=1, stop_is_valid=1, terminal_codons_valid=1; ATGGCACTCAAAGCA -> terminal_codons_valid=0
